finalists.label: Cystic Fibrosis
finalists.why: It has strong genetic evidence with F508del/3849 + 10kbC-T mutation and uncertain initial sweat tests.

finalists.label: Chronic Respiratory Infection
finalists.why: It is supported by frequent respiratory episodes and regular oropharyngeal samples showing bacterial presence.

frontier_selector.why: The genetic testing revealing F508del/3849 + 10kbC-T mutation and uncertain initial sweat tests provided decisive evidence for Cystic Fibrosis.

support_spans: Initial sweat tests were uncertain (42-60 mmol/l)
Genetic testing at 12 months revealed F508del/3849 + 10kbC-T mutation
frequent respiratory episodes during first year of life
developed Pseudo-Bartter's syndrome (hypochloremia, hyponatremia, hypokalemia, and metabolic alkalosis)
regular oropharyngeal samples showed bacterial presence in amounts of 102-104 colony-forming units
February 2019: Sputum sample negative, nasal lavage fluid showed 32 colony-forming units/ml

contradict_spans: vitamin D level was within normal range

support_spans: Computer tomography confirmed inflammatory alteration of the paranasal sinuses
contradict_spans: Lung computer tomography showed no signs of damage
